seo.title: Gripello – route management for climbing gyms
seo.description: Hosted route management for climbing and bouldering gyms: gym map, logbook, ratings, task board, analytics and competitions on gripello.app.

hero.title: Route management your climbers actually use
hero.description: Gripello brings your gym's routes, map, logbook, defect reports and competitions into one fast app – hosted by us, for setters, staff and every climber on the wall.
hero.primary: Book a demo or free trial

climbers.headline: For climbers
climbers.title: Everything on the wall, in your pocket
climbers.description: Open your gym on gripello.app – no account needed to browse. Climbers find routes on the map and log their sends.

map.title: Interactive gym map
map.description: Floor plan per location with every route in its hold colour, filters by grade and colour, and sent/total counts per wall.

logbook.title: Logbook that works offline
logbook.description: Flash, top or attempts, grade pyramid, progression and projects. Ticks sync as soon as the phone is back online.

community.title: Ratings, friends and leaderboards
community.description: Stars and grade feedback per route, a friends feed, gym leaderboards and achievements – updated live.

scan.title: QR codes on every route
scan.description: Scan the sign at the wall to jump straight to the route page.

defects.title: Report a spinning hold
defects.description: Climbers report loose holds and bolts from the route page and hear back once it is fixed.

app.title: Push and home-screen widgets
app.description: The apps bring push notifications and home-screen widgets, so climbers hear about new routes and see their progress at a glance.

climbers.ios: iOS app coming soon. Until then, iPhone climbers install gripello.app from the browser.

gyms.headline: For gyms
gyms.title: The tools your setting team needs
gyms.description: From the first route on the wall to the reset, with the data to decide what to set next.

routes.title: Routes, signs and inventory
routes.description: Create routes or import them from a spreadsheet, print QR route signs and keep the inventory current with the built-in scanner.

placement.title: Floor plan and reset planning
placement.description: Draw walls once, place routes from your phone and see which walls are due for a reset by age, ticks, ratings and defects.

tasks.title: From defect to fix
tasks.description: Defect reports and route wishes land on a kanban board with assignees and due dates. Urgent defects trigger a mail.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Grade distribution and balance per discipline, set vs. perceived grade, setter output and activity heatmaps.

screens.title: Screens in the gym
screens.description: Show new routes, the leaderboard, planned resets and announcements on any TV. A running competition takes over.

compliance.title: Roles, audit log and DSA
compliance.description: Custom roles with fine-grained permissions, an activity log, a moderation inbox for reports under the EU Digital Services Act (DSA) and two-factor sign-in.

competitions.headline: Competitions
competitions.title: Run your own boulder or rope competition
competitions.description: Sign-up, scoring, live results and certificates – using the routes already in Gripello. Included at no extra cost.

scorecard.title: Phone scorecard
scorecard.description: Climbers score attempts, zones and tops themselves, even without signal.

judges.title: Judge entry
judges.description: Judges enter lead heights and staff can correct any score.

live.title: Live results and TV mode
live.description: Rankings per category on any screen, frozen for the final minutes if you like.

exports.title: Results and certificates
exports.description: Start lists, results as PDF or XLSX and certificates with your logo.

formats.fixed: Fixed points that drop per attempt
formats.routePoints: Route points for lead and toprope

hosting.headline: Hosting
hosting.title: We host it, you set routes
hosting.description: Same app either way. Your data stays yours.

hosted.title: Hosted on gripello.app
hosted.description: Updates, backups and mail are taken care of. Write to us and we send you a link to set up your gym with a free trial.

self.title: On your own server
self.description: The source is available under BUSL-1.1, a source-available licence. Evaluation is free; running it for your gym needs a commercial licence – ask us.

cost.question: What does it cost?
cost.answer: A monthly subscription per gym, with every feature and competitions included. Write to hello{'@'}gripello.com for a quote and a free trial.

import.question: Can we bring our existing routes?
import.answer: Yes. Import routes and their reviews from CSV, XLSX or JSON, TopLogger grades included.

grades.question: Which grading scales are supported?
grades.answer: UIAA, French and YDS for routes, Fontainebleau and V-scale for boulders, plus your own boulder colour circuits.

languages.question: Which languages are available?
languages.answer: Gripello is translated into several languages, and every user picks their own. Translations can be contributed on GitHub.

privacy.question: Where is our data stored?
privacy.answer: On gripello.app, run by us – or on your own server with a self-hosting licence. Members export their data themselves, and Gripello brings imprint and privacy pages per gym and a moderation inbox for reports under the EU Digital Services Act (DSA).

app.question: Is there an app to download?
app.answer: Yes. The Android app is on Google Play, the iOS app is coming soon to the App Store. Until then, iPhone climbers open gripello.app in the browser and install it to the home screen.

selfHost.question: Can we host Gripello ourselves?
selfHost.answer: Yes, with a commercial licence. The source is on GitHub under BUSL-1.1, a source-available licence, and every version becomes Apache-2.0 four years after its release.

scale.question: Will it hold up on a busy evening?
scale.answer: Yes. Public pages are cached and live updates are pushed efficiently, so a full gym evening stays fast.
